2609.09153.title: Procedural Graphs: Self-Evolving Execution Structures for LLM Agents
2609.09153.paper_summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents that plan over long horizons and act through external tools. Most agents select actions through unconstrained generation over an accumulating history, leaving implicit the procedural knowledge of what to do, in what order, and under which conditions. As trajectories lengthen, agents can lose track of their objectives, invoke tools out of order, and repeat unproductive actions. We introduce the Procedural Graph: just as a knowledge graph organizes factual knowledge into (entity, relation, entity) triplets for what-is questions, a Procedural Graph organizes procedural knowledge into (procedure, relation, procedure) triplets for what-to-do questions. At each decision step, the framework localizes the agent's active node, and a guidance model translates the surrounding subgraph into step-level situational guidance that biases the solver's next action without dictating it. The graph is self-evolving: an LLM refiner contrasts failed trajectories with successful ones and edits the graph's topology and attributes, committing edits that preserve or improve held-out validation performance while retaining rejected ones to discourage repetition. Starting from a minimal skeleton, the loop builds graphs that match or surpass hand-designed ones. It can also repair a flawed expert prior. Across multiple datasets, task types, and LLMs, the Procedural Graph delivers consistent gains over memory-based baselines, and self-evolution further improves performance without manual engineering.
2609.09153.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型越來越多地被用作計劃長期目標並通過外部工具行動的代理。大多數代理通過在累積歷史上進行不受限制的生成來選擇行動，隱含了在什麼順序和什麼條件下該做什麼的程序性知識。隨著軌跡的延長，代理可能會失去對其目標的追蹤，錯誤地調用工具，並重複無效的行動。我們引入了程序圖：正如知識圖將事實知識組織成（實體，關係，實體）三元組以回答什麼是的問題，程序圖則將程序性知識組織成（程序，關係，程序）三元組以回答該做什麼的問題。在每個決策步驟中，該框架定位代理的主動節點，而指導模型將周圍的子圖轉換為步驟級的情境指導，這會影響解決者的下一個行動而不強制其行動。該圖是自我演化的：一個LLM精煉器將失敗的軌跡與成功的軌跡進行對比，並編輯圖的拓撲和屬性，承諾的編輯保留或改善保留驗證性能，同時保留被拒絕的部分以防止重複。從一個最小的骨架開始，這個循環構建出匹配或超越手工設計的圖形。它還可以修復有缺陷的專家先驗。在多個數據集、任務類型和LLM中，程序圖在基於記憶的基準上提供了一致的增益，自我演化進一步改善了性能，而無需手動工程。
